headings.description: Elegant, mystic, and transformative. Ideal for a high-end psychology vibe.

body.description: Clean, modern, and readable. Wide tracking for small labels to enhance the cinematic feel.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively on the header, a central quote/CTA card, and bottom utilities. Do not cover the main video entirely.
visual_enhancers.overlay: A very subtle radial gradient overlay (black/70 at edges to black/20 in center) on top of the video to ensure text readability while letting the center shine.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) on all glass elements to define edges against the dark background.

grids.general: Single screen layout (h-screen). Absolute positioning for background media, flexbox for centering content.
grids.header: flex justify-between items-center w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto

layouts.structure: Single striking hero screen. No scrolling required. Content should be vertically and horizontally centered with space around.
layouts.spacing: p-6 md:p-12 for outer bounds. Generous internal padding (p-8 to p-12) for glass cards.

motion.kinetic_typography: Implement a Blur-to-Sharp stagger reveal for the main heading ('The Source: Find Yourself'). Characters/words start with opacity 0, filter: blur(12px), y: 20 and animate to opacity 1, blur(0px), y: 0 with a slight stagger delay (0.05s).
motion.page_load: Start with a black screen that fades out to reveal the video and UI components over 1.5 seconds.
motion.hover_states: Links and buttons should have subtle opacity shifts (white/70 to white) and a slow transform transition (duration-300).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the gradient overlay is dark enough behind the main text. Use text-shadow if necessary for the ultra-thin serif fonts.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the kinetic typography by falling back to a simple opacity fade.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="nav-home-link"').

video_background.usage: Fullscreen, object-cover, fixed background behind all UI. Muted, looping, playsinline.

3d_libraries_and_steps.framer_motion: Use for the kinetic typography reveal and layout transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a single-page, full-height (100vh) landing page with no scrolling.
Place the provided 4K video as an absolute/fixed background, covering the entire viewport.
Apply a subtle vignette/radial dark overlay over the video so the center is mostly clear but edges are dark, keeping text readable.
Build a floating, glassmorphic header at the top. Use 'bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10' for the glass effect.
In the center, implement kinetic typography using Framer Motion. The text 'The Source : Find Yourself' should reveal word-by-word or char-by-char, transitioning from blurred to sharp.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for the large, mystic headings, and 'Montserrat' for tiny, wide-tracked navigational elements.
Do NOT clutter the screen. Minimal content. Add just a few placeholder navigation links and maybe a 'Begin Journey' button.
Ensure the glassmorphism does NOT use a fully transparent background; it must have a slight tint and border to look like physical glass.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container using .App { text-align: center; }.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, etc.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute for testing.
